summary: Frontend-only test of the uploaded Husband K figure at 390x844 and 1280x800. The file is used verbatim: the RAW string in huskK.js is byte-identical (14404 bytes) to public/assets/husband-K-figure.svg and to /app/scripts/hk/husband-K-final/husband-K-figure.svg. Meet /meet/a5yxsmhb and /h/a5yxsmhb: [data-testid=face-cameo] .hk-fig svg contains #K-eyes, #K-hair and #K-mouth. The face matches the reference (hair, teal eyes, brows, smirk). band-line-0..2 ('STEADY HAND · HOLDS ME', 'VOICE NOTES · ADVENTURES', 'PET'S NAME') are fill rgb(241,236,225) and sit inside the oval. ribbon-name is bone. There were 0 console or page errors. Emotions at 1280: taps cycled blush, hearts, kiss, sigh, shy, smile, wink, and each returned to idle. Computed effects: wink scaleY(0.06) on #K-eyes children 7-12 only; hearts set the eye circles to opacity 0 and the heart overlay group to 1, with #K-mouth at 0; smile set the mouth to 0 and the grin to 1, eyes scaleY .72; sigh rotated .hk-move by -3deg and closed the eyes; kiss closed the eyes and showed the pucker plus a floater; blush translated the circles 2.5px with the flush at .6; shy translated (-3, 2.5). I saved i15_emotion_{idle,blush,hearts,kiss,sigh,shy,smile,wink}.png. Full flow at 1280: BuildingHusband, the /bands preview and the weaving hoop (fades 0.32 to 0.9) all render the uploaded figure (#K-hair present). The share reveal and GET /api/husbands/a5yxsmhb/card.jpg?v=7 (200, image/jpeg, 1080x1920, 522KB) show the uploaded figure. Contrast: selected option bone rgb(241,236,225) on moss rgb(74,86,65); selected band chips bone on wine rgb(107,46,54); ribbon-name bone. Main issue: in every cameo, the storyboard's old egg figure still peeks out beside and below his clipped shoulders. His abs are also mostly hidden.

ui_bugs.issue: The OLD storyboard figure peeks through on both sides of his shoulders and lower chest, as dark wicker band strips and coarse wicker texture outside his clip. Cause: the mist Backdrop and the figure clipPath use ellipse cx414.5 cy392 rx210 ry256. The art's real window in /art/meet-cameo.svg is wider at the bottom, roughly x207-622 and y135-655, with a flatter bottom. The old figure's bands span about x225-605 at y≈540-600, outside the ellipse. Verified by overlaying the ellipse on meet-cameo.svg (i15_art_cameo_window.jpeg) and in the zooms i15_zoom_chest1280.png and i15_zoom_chest390.png.

issues: Abs are barely visible. The 3 band strokes (width font+9=29 at 30 spacing) merge into one solid wine block over the whole pec area. Below that, only the top abs row shows faintly before the oval bottom and the 'meet <name>' banner cover the rest. The reference shows pecs plus 3 rows of abs. The request said face and abs should be visible.
His shoulders end in a hard elliptical clip edge (ellipse(42% 41%)) instead of running to the frame like the reference. Together with the peeking old figure, the lower oval looks layered.
At 390, the band text is ~10-12px tall and squeezed with textLength, giving uneven kerning ('ST EADY', 'ADVENTU RES').
Overlay always draws a lantern heart at (200,300) on his chest, which the user's file does not have. If 'verbatim' is strict, confirm with the user that this is acceptable.
In kiss and sigh, the scaled eyes become a thin slit and the lid stroke is drawn over it, so the closed eyes read as a double line. Minor.
The figure is clipped to an ellipse inside the hoop, so his torso ends in a hard curved edge with cloth around it. No old figure is visible. This is acceptable but slightly 'cut-out' looking.

action_items: HIGH: Make the cameo Backdrop cover the art's full inner window so no old figure shows. Use the window path traced from meet-cameo.svg, or a larger and lower shape (e.g. a rect clipped to the frame's inner ring). Also enlarge the figure's clip to match, so his shoulders reach the window edge.
Make the abs visible in the cameo. Thin the band strokes (e.g. strokeWidth ≈ font+2 with lower opacity) and/or move the figure up or scale it slightly so the abs sit above the ribbon banner.
Optional: drop the always-on chest lantern heart from Overlay if 'verbatim' must be strict; reduce the squeeze on the 390 band text.
critical_code_review_comments: Face.jsx: SPOTS.cameo.clip and fig.clipPath are hand-tuned ellipses that don't match the art window. This is the root cause of the peeking old figure.

The overlay filter ids (hko-soft, hko-glow) and the backdrop ids (hkb-cameo-*) repeat across Face instances. BuildingHusband renders 2 cameo Faces, and the injected RAW svg's ids (Kw, Kf, Khd...) are duplicated on every instance and in StillHusband. Today the defs are identical so it renders correctly, but it is fragile: if the first instance is display:none, Chrome and Safari can drop pattern/clip references.
Face.jsx re-subscribes play on every render (useEffect without deps). This is harmless but wasteful.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all functional checks pass; old-figure peeking and hidden abs fail the visual acceptance)
